# What Atlas service account secrets the library redacts, and what it leaves
# alone.
#
# Every secret here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no
# real credential is. That run is sixteen characters and a body is forty, so a
# body carries on through the alphabet to z and then back to 0. Where a case is
# about one position of the body rather than about the count, that position is
# rewritten and the rest of the run is left standing, so the body still comes to
# forty.

patterns: atlas-service-account-secret

# The one prefix MongoDB issues a service account secret with. There is no
# second kind of string here: an account may hold more than one secret at a
# time so that a replacement can be brought in before the old one is dropped,
# and nothing in the value says which of them is which, so the cases below are
# the one shape in the places a secret is written.

case:     a secret in an environment assignment
in:       MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET=mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET=«atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a secret in the client credentials request the administration api issues a token from
in:       client_id=mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdef01234567&client_secret=mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      client_id=mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdef01234567&client_secret=«atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a secret in json
in:       {"secret":"mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123"}
out:      {"secret":"«atlas-service-account-secret»"}

case:     a secret on a command line
in:       curl -u "mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdef01234567:mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123" https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas/v2/groups
out:      curl -u "mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdef01234567:«atlas-service-account-secret»" https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas/v2/groups

case:     a secret in a configuration environment block
in:       "env": {"MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET": "mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123"}
out:      "env": {"MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET": "«atlas-service-account-secret»"}

case:     a secret in yaml
in:       client_secret: mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      client_secret: «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a secret in a diff line
in:       +MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET=mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      +MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET=«atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a secret in a markdown code span
in:       `mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123`
out:      `«atlas-service-account-secret»`

# The client ID standing beside a secret, which this pattern does not read: the
# two are the username and the password of one account, and a caller keeping a
# log keyed on which account acted needs the first left in the text while the
# second goes. The second case writes a body of this pattern's width behind the
# identifier's own kind, so that only the kind decides it.

case:     a client id on its own
in:       client_id=mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      client_id=mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     the identifier's kind with a body of this width behind it
in:       mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_id_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

# The alphabet the forty characters are written in. It is base64url — the
# letters of both cases, the digits, the hyphen and the underscore. The two
# characters standard base64 writes in place of the last of those, the plus sign
# and the slash, are not admitted, and neither is the equals sign a padded
# encoding closes on.

case:     a body written in capitals
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body opening on a hyphen
in:       mdb_sa_sk_-123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body closing on a hyphen
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012-
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body opening on an underscore
in:       mdb_sa_sk__123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body closing on an underscore
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012_
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body opening on the last letter of the alphabet
in:       mdb_sa_sk_z123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body closing on the last letter of the alphabet
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012z
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body carrying a plus sign
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmno+qrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmno+qrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a body carrying a slash
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmno/qrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmno/qrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a body carrying an equals sign
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmno=qrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmno=qrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a dot straight behind the prefix
in:       mdb_sa_sk_.123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_sk_.123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a space straight behind the prefix
in:       mdb_sa_sk_ 123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_sk_ 123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

# The lengths either side of forty. The count is read exactly rather than as a
# floor: a body is written in an alphabet that holds the hyphen and the
# underscore, so a run does not stop where a word written against a secret
# begins, and a floor would take that word with the secret. So thirty-nine
# characters are not a secret, and forty-one are a secret and the character
# written after it.

case:     a body of forty characters is a secret
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a body of thirty-nine characters is not
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012
out:      mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012

case:     an alphabet run longer than the count is a secret and what follows it
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz01234
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»4

case:     a run twenty-four characters longer than the count
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqr
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»456789abcdefghijklmnopqr

# The prefix as MongoDB writes it. It is read in the one case, and with the
# underscores it is divided by rather than the hyphens a delimiter is elsewhere.
# The last case is the prefix short of its first character, which is what a line
# read from an offset or trimmed at its left edge leaves: a body stands behind
# it, and the prefix it would have to open on does not.

case:     the prefix written in capitals
in:       MDB_SA_SK_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      MDB_SA_SK_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     the prefix written in mixed case
in:       Mdb_Sa_Sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      Mdb_Sa_Sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     hyphens where the prefix carries underscores
in:       mdb-sa-sk-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb-sa-sk-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     the prefix without the underscore that closes it
in:       mdb_sa_sk0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      mdb_sa_sk0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a run of the right length opening with no prefix
in:       0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a prefix the front of the input cut short
in:       db_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      db_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

# What a secret may be written against. There is no boundary on either side of
# the prefix, so a secret keeps its span whatever word character it abuts — and
# the count ends it at its fiftieth character, so whatever is written after one
# stays in the text whether the alphabet admits it or not.

case:     a secret after an underscore
in:       MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET_mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET_«atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a secret after a letter
in:       xmdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      x«atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a word written against a secret
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123suffix
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»suffix

case:     a hyphenated word written against a secret
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123-suffix
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»-suffix

case:     an underscored word written against a secret
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123_backup
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»_backup

case:     a secret at the end of a sentence
in:       the secret is mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123.
out:      the secret is «atlas-service-account-secret».

case:     a secret immediately against japanese on both sides
in:       シークレットはmdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123です
out:      シークレットは«atlas-service-account-secret»です

case:     a secret against an invalid byte
in:       \xffmdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123\xff
out:      \xff«atlas-service-account-secret»\xff

# Two secrets written together. Every character of the prefix belongs to the
# alphabet a body is written in, so the prefix can stand inside the body of the
# secret before it; the second secret begins ten characters into the first, the
# two spans overlap and are redacted as one. Written with nothing at all between
# them the two are separate values, since the count ends the first where the
# second opens.

case:     a secret beginning inside the secret before it
in:       mdb_sa_sk_mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     two secrets with nothing between them
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123mdb_sa_sk_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»«atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     two secrets separated by a space
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123 mdb_sa_sk_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret» «atlas-service-account-secret»

# What this pattern redacts that nobody issued. The prefix holds three
# underscores, which hexadecimal, base62, standard base64 and base32 write
# nowhere, so only a base64url encoding can spell one — and where forty
# characters of the alphabet follow, those fifty characters are redacted whether
# or not Atlas issued them. Such a run is a secret's format exactly and nothing
# in the text tells the two apart, so sparing it would spare a real secret
# written the same way.
#
# The digest is the same over-match taking a value a reader had a use for. The
# hexadecimal digits are base64url and a digest carries nothing that ends a run,
# so a SHA-1 written behind the prefix is exactly a body and goes with it whole,
# and a SHA-256 is longer so the first forty characters of it go while the rest
# stays. What holds the other side of it is the count — an MD5 and a UUID are
# short of a body, and a UUID's hyphens are in the alphabet, so it is the count
# that turns one away and not the separators. The UUID is also the shape this
# property was declared with before the count read here superseded it, which
# this pattern decided against reading, so that case is where a value of that
# shape is left in the text.
#
# The last case is the encoding that carries none of this. Standard base64
# writes + and / where base64url writes the hyphen and the underscore, so a
# certificate body holds no prefix to be found at however long it runs.

case:     the prefix inside a longer run of base64url
in:       payload=zzzzmdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123zzzz
out:      payload=zzzz«atlas-service-account-secret»zzzz

case:     the prefix where a signature stands
in:       eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzzmdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123zzzz
out:      eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzz«atlas-service-account-secret»zzzz

case:     a sha1 behind the prefix, exactly a body
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»

case:     a sha256 behind the prefix
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      «atlas-service-account-secret»89abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     an md5 behind the prefix
in:       mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      mdb_sa_sk_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a uuid behind the prefix
in:       mdb_sa_sk_01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      mdb_sa_sk_01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     a sha1 behind a hyphen rather than the prefix
in:       mdb-sa-sk-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      mdb-sa-sk-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a certificate body in standard base64
in:       MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA0123456789abcdef+/0123456789abcdef
out:      MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA0123456789abcdef+/0123456789abcdef
